description: This source file defines the internal class ClusterManifestProvider, which implements the IClusterManifestProvider, IAsyncDisposable, IDisposable, and ILifecycleParticipant interfaces. It manages the cluster manifest updates in an Orleans cluster, including initializing, processing membership updates, retrieving silo manifests, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: ClusterManifestProvider
classes.description: An internal class responsible for providing and updating the cluster manifest in Orleans, handling membership updates, fetching silo manifests, and participating in the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: ClusterManifestProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cluster manifest provider with required dependencies and setting up initial state.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Property returning the current cluster manifest.

methods.name: Updates
methods.description: Property exposing an asynchronous sequence of cluster manifest updates.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Private async method that continuously processes membership updates and updates the cluster manifest accordingly.

methods.name: UpdateManifest
methods.description: Private async method that updates the manifest based on the current cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Begins processing membership updates asynchronously during the runtime lifecycle.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes required services, notably the internal grain factory.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the processing of membership updates and shuts down the provider.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the provider to lifecycle events for initialization and shutdown.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of resources, ensuring proper shutdown.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Synchronously disposes of resources, calls DisposeAsync.

methods.name: LogWarningErrorRetrievingSiloManifest
methods.description: Logs a warning when an error occurs retrieving a silo manifest.

methods.name: LogDebugStartingToProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs a debug message indicating the start of membership update processing.

methods.name: LogDebugStoppedProcessingMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Logs a debug message indicating the stop of membership update processing.
